name: lock_server_sync-cal
cmd: GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 150 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only lock_server_sync --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'small instance|join (enumerated|end|failed|pool|td|engine|set|cone|houdini|meters)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-260 | tail -c 9000; tail -c 1500 /tmp/err.log | grep -iE 'error|throw' | tail -3; exit $s
